preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of roads m is sufficient to connect all cities (graph is connected).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].
The number of edges provided matches m.
The graph formed by the cities and roads is connected.

postconditions.expression: output_value == max(avg_safe_roads(p) for p in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum average number of safe roads achievable by placing the police station in any city p from 1 to n.
The printed value matches the calculated maximum with an absolute error less than 10^-6.
